releases.title: The Aerospace & Naval Update — into the air and out to sea
releases.summary: Cherry gains aircraft, airports and ships. You can walk about on a flying aircraft or a ship under way.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Two aircraft: the Cherry Stratos-900 passenger and freight ferry and the Cherry Aegis-X stealth fighter, with a first-person cockpit, artificial horizon and reticle, retracting gear, flaps and afterburner.

Airport fittings: PAPI lights that change colour with your approach angle, a catapult to launch an aircraft, an arresting wire that catches a lowered tail hook, and a control radar that shows the aircraft around it.

Two ships: the 48 m Cherry Leviathan-Class ocean car ferry and the 64 m Cherry Dreadnought-Class guided missile destroyer. Put one on the water, take the wheel to steer, or lay a route at the chart table and she will sail it, keeping clear of shallows.

Only the Dreadnought-Class is armed: a 406 mm railgun turret that trains and elevates independently and rocks the hull when it fires, and a VLS that launches only once its hatch is fully open. The car ferry carries no armament.
Deck walking: run and jump about on a moving aircraft or ship. The deck under you carries you with it.
A ship goes back into your hand when she is stopped and nobody is on her deck. She remembers the damage she took, so putting her back on the water does not mend her.

sections.title: Warnings
items: Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, Fabric API 0.161.0 or newer, GeckoLib 5.5.6 or newer and Java 25.

releases.title: Now on Minecraft 26.3
releases.summary: Cherry now runs on Minecraft 26.3. Everything from V1.0.0 comes along, and on a Moon you have already visited, newly generated ground meets the old.

sections.title: Highlights
items: Everything V1.0.0 added runs on Minecraft 26.3: the Moon, the Cherry Apex-1 and the Launch Pad Complex, the lunar rules, Overdrive Fusion, the lunar resources, Micrometeorites and both skills.
Worlds from V1.0.0 carry on: on the Moon, newly generated ground gets the same terrain and the same craters as V1.0.0, so it meets the ground you have already explored.

sections.title: Warnings

releases.title: The Lunar Genesis Update — from the launch pad to the Moon
releases.summary: Cherry's first release: a separate mod brand that installs beside Alpha. Build the Launch Pad Complex, fly the Cherry Apex-1 to the Moon, and come home again.

sections.title: Highlights
items: The Moon: a new dimension with craters, ore deposits and Helium-3 Geysers, and a clock of its own.
Cherry Apex-1 and the Launch Pad Complex: board the docked rocket, hold jump through the countdown, and fly from the Overworld to the Moon and back to the pad with the pilot aboard.
Lunar rules: gravity is one sixth, and the vacuum takes 15% of maximum health through any armour except the Pressure Suit. Inside a Pressure Field Projector's sphere you are safe.
Overdrive Fusion: in the Resonance Crucible, an overdriven weapon, tool or armour piece gets ×3 attack damage, armour, toughness or mining speed.
Lunar resources: the Ultrasonic Cutter extracts Regolith Core Deposits only while in resonance, and the Cryo Canister captures Helium-3 only while a geyser is erupting.
Micrometeorites strike the lunar surface and leave craters.
Two skills: Dimensional Cleave (300% damage along its cross only) and Astral Lift, flight with an overdriven chestplate.
Checked to start alongside all 13 Alpha 4.4.0 mods with no mixin conflicts.

sections.title: Warnings
items: Requires Minecraft 26.2, Fabric Loader 0.19.3 or later, Fabric API 0.154.2 or later, GeckoLib 5.5.5 or later, and Java 25.
